open_points.subject: 50_public_apis_0_conventions.md:Conventions every operation follows
open_points.text: one entry for each failing input or record, each naming the field or the identity it concerns; within one kind, entries are ordered first by the record or input they concern — inputs in the order the operation's Inputs list them, then records list by list in that same order, each list in its own order (A06) — and then, within one record or input, by its fields in the order its Inputs or model lists them.
open_points.question: When one input or record has several failing fields of the same error kind, must the answer contain one entry for the input or record, or one entry for each failing field?
options: One entry for the input or record, identifying all of its failing fields
One separate entry for each failing field, ordered by field
One entry for only the first failing field
open_points.default_guess: Return one separate entry for each failing field, because the answer must name every failure and the text defines their field order.

witness.initial: A project-create input gives floor area 0 and number of rooms 0, both out-of-form values at stage (4).
events: The owner submits the create operation.
given_values finds both failures in the same project input and operations constructs the stage-(4) error answer.
outcomes: The phrase "one entry for each failing input" produces one error entry, requiring both fields to be combined or one to be omitted.
The field-order clause produces two error entries, one for floor area and one for number of rooms, in model-field order.

open_points.subject: 50_public_apis_0_conventions.md:Conventions every operation follows
open_points.text: then records list by list in that same order, each list in its own order (A06)
open_points.question: What declared order determines the order of multiple record lists when records from more than one list have failures of the same kind?
options: The order in which the operation's Inputs section names the record lists
The order in which the operation's Outputs or mapping structure names the lists
The order in which the relevant models or checks are named
A fixed global order that this convention must state
open_points.default_guess: Use the order in which the operation contract first names the record lists, and use A06 only within each list.

open_points.subject: 50_public_apis_0_conventions.md:Conventions every operation follows
open_points.text: each naming the field or the identity it concerns; within one kind, entries are ordered first by the record or input they concern — inputs in the order the operation's Inputs list them, then records list by list in that same order, each list in its own order (A06) — and then, within one record or input, by its fields in the order its Inputs or model lists them.
open_points.question: Where is an identity-level error entry placed relative to field-level entries for the same input or record, since an identity has no position in the stated field order?
options: Identity entry before all field entries for that input or record
Identity entry after all field entries for that input or record
A model or Inputs declaration must assign the identity an explicit field position
open_points.default_guess: Treat the identity as the first field of its record and place its entry before other field entries.
